en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large rectangular stone building with a tiled roof, simple windows, and a stone retaining wall in the foreground. The image is slightly faded and printed with a wide margin on the right, where a caption identifies the scene as the British consulate in Argostoli. There is also a small publisher's imprint along the left side and a modern website watermark at the bottom.
